title: Lempel–Ziv factorization

problem.name: Lempel–Ziv factorization
problem.statement_latex: Given indexed access to $S\in\Sigma^n$, output its LZ77 factorization into $z$ phrases, each extending the longest previously occurring prefix under the chosen LZ77 convention. The resource is character queries and random-access time.
problem.statement_text: Given indexed access to $S\in\Sigma^n$, output its LZ77 factorization into $z$ phrases, each extending the longest previously occurring prefix under the chosen LZ77 convention. The resource is character queries and random-access time.
